items.title: EU taps industry to set standards for tokenized securities
items.sum: Applications close Nov. 27 for an industry group that aims to draft initial standards for holding and settling tokenized securities by early 2028.

items.title: Coinbase's US national trust bank charter takes effect
items.sum: Coinbase plans to expand its institutional crypto custody business under the federal charter and is exploring digital asset payment products.

items.title: Robinhood opens access to US IPOs for UK retail investors
items.sum: Robinhood's UK customers can request shares in eligible US initial public offerings at the offer price before the stocks begin trading.

items.title: BTC price eyes $73K amid Nvidia volatility: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
items.sum: Bitcoin price action fell to its lowest levels since mid-August as Nvidia reports added to sell-side pressure across stock-market futures.

items.title: Binance, Tether and Trump crypto firms face Senate records deadline
items.sum: Sen. Richard Blumenthal asked four crypto firms to start sending records by Nov. 20 as part of a Senate investigation into their activities.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs shed $1.3B in biggest weekly outflow since late June
items.sum: Investors pulled a net $1.21 billion from BlackRock's IBIT last week as Bitcoin fell below $76,000 and US technology stocks sold off.

items.title: Microsoft-Backed Space and Time Launches Platform to Let AI Agents Verify Private Data
items.sum: Space and Time Enterprise uses Proof of SQL to prove calculations on private business data without exposing the records to AI agents.

items.title: Coinbase Joins Circle, Ripple With Final OCC Approval for Federal Trust Bank Charter
items.sum: The exchange will move its institutional crypto custody business under federal oversight, building on its 2018 New York trust charter.

items.title: Trump Says He Knows 'Nothing' About World Liberty Financial as He Defends UAE Ties
items.sum: Pressed on why he doesn't divest from the family's crypto venture, Trump said his sons run the business and every president faces conflicts.

items.title: Nvidia Board Investigates Jensen Huang After Report He Was Target of Chinese Spy Effort
items.sum: Huang told staff he had been 'unfaithful' to his wife, as Nvidia shares fell nearly 5% in premarket trading on Monday.

items.title: This Bitcoin Developer's Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
items.sum: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets.

items.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
items.sum: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

items.title: Formation notifies SEC to operate first tokenized securities venue on Solana
items.sum: Launch is expected in early 2027, with tokenized shares of Exodus Movement, Forward Industries, and Galaxy Digital among initial offerings.

items.title: Nvidia perps slide as market reacts to CEO Jensen Huang's Chinese spy scandal
items.sum: Nvidia said its board of directors is investigating Huang's relationship with a woman identified by intelligence officials as a Chinese spy.

items.title: Aave's DAO is considering a $50 million buyout of the lending protocol's equity
items.sum: The proposal would see the DAO acquire Aave's equity from its founding company in a deal valued at $50 million.

items.title: TeraWulf's bitcoin mining revenue falls 69% as HPC leasing surges amid Anthropic buildout
items.sum: TeraWulf reported $63 million in artificial intelligence-related quarterly HPC lease revenue, up 774% year over year.

items.title: Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $1.3 billion as Nvidia scandal rocks markets
items.sum: Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw their largest weekly outflow since June as tech stocks sold off.

items.title: Solana's Shanghai event halted over unauthorized promotion: Report
items.sum: Local authorities stopped the event after discovering it had not obtained required approvals for the promotional activities.

items.title: Tokenized gold can now back a Coinbase loan. The price feed takes weekends off
items.sum: Morpho says PAXG-backed USDC loans are live, while customer eligibility, borrowing limits and liquidation thresholds still apply.

items.title: Thailand is cutting off Bitget users have until December 5 to prepare
items.sum: The regulator asks customers to consider action on holdings before the block, while Bitget promises guidance on service access.

items.title: One BlackRock fund dominates Bitcoin's billion-dollar ETF exodus
items.sum: Fidelity finished positive in the November 2-6 week, but the other funds collectively remained negative without IBIT.

items.title: The diesel problem that could spoil Bitcoin's hopes for cheaper money
items.sum: National inventories fell to 99.259 million barrels, while lower weekly diesel and heating-oil prices kept the financing risk conditional.

items.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade delayed over smart contract risks
items.sum: Developers are investigating eight smart contract invariants tied to EIP-8037 and EIP-8038 before proceeding with the Hoodi fork.

items.title: Coinbase loan against tokenized gold highlights weekend price feed gaps
items.sum: PAXG collateral for USDC loans is live but oracles do not update over weekends.

items.title: U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows
items.sum: FinCEN issued a final order under section 9714(a) that will bar U.S. financial institutions from sending or receiving funds with MEXC Global.

items.title: Former FBI Agent Pleads Guilty to Stealing $2.47 Million in Crypto From Investigations
items.sum: Patrick Steven Yaroch pleaded guilty to wire fraud and money laundering after using wallet credentials from 35 FBI investigations.

items.title: Bitcoin Price Drops Below $75K as Nvidia Scandal Hits Risk Assets
items.sum: BTC fell to levels not seen since mid-August amid broader tech selloff.

items.title: Quantum Computing Threat to Bitcoin Wallets Draws Developer Proposals
items.sum: Proposals include requiring collateral from potential quantum attackers.

items.title: FinCEN Order Against MEXC Takes Effect in 30 Days
items.sum: US financial institutions will be barred from transacting with the exchange.

items.title: ETF Outflows Continue as Bitcoin Tests Key Support
items.sum: Largest weekly outflow since late June as IBIT leads the exits.

items.title: Solana set for its first tokenized stock venue under SEC framework, listing Galaxy
items.sum: Formation Securities plans to launch in early 2027 with Galaxy, Exodus and Forward Industries shares, expanding the U.S. regulator's experiment in blockchain-based stock trading.

items.title: Trump says he knows 'nothing' about World Liberty's UAE ties as Justin Sun challenges filings
items.sum: Trump confirmed he co-owns World Liberty, whose UAE ownership could derail Justin Sun's federal lawsuit over frozen WLFI tokens

items.title: Bitcoin bulls can't rely on ETF flows
items.sum: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 9, 2026

items.title: Nvidia-led tech selloff weighs on crypto majors
items.sum: Only five of the top 100 cryptocurrencies by market value are up 1% or more over the past 24 hours. That is the state of the market today.

items.title: Zcash developers want 20-second blocks just days after major speed upgrade
items.sum: Early data shows Zcash's orphan-block rate holding close to pre-upgrade levels despite blocks arriving three times faster, encouraging developers to push for even faster blocks.

items.title: Live news: Bitcoin slides to $74,000 as Huang scandal weighs on Nvidia
items.sum: Neocloud stocks retreat after Friday's rally, while gold holds above $4,000 and bitcoin trades near $74,000.
